doc.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Jazz Profiles and the Peabody Award
summary: She is proud of hosting Jazz Profiles.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: I just have a few more questions. Jazz Profiles.

I wish I was still doing it. It’s still being played, but – I learned more from it. I learned more about the people. I had a wonderful time doing it, because I really got to know people that I only had heard about and people that I thought I knew. There was so much – the scripts were so great, so good. That was something I’m proud of. I’m proud of the Peabody Award for that.
